title: Dotson leaves

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Hello partner! How did it go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello partner! How did it go?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Yes, I agree, but we need more evidence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I agree, but we need more evidence.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Perhaps we can turn one of his accomplices against him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps we can turn one of his accomplices against him.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: None of his close circle would dare betray him, but... a freelancer might. If he has contracted "muscle" recently, like a bounty hunter perhaps...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None of his close circle would dare betray him, but... a freelancer might. If he has contracted "muscle" recently, like a bounty hunter perhaps...

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Precisely, but there is no "we" this time. You must do this one on your own, old friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Precisely, but there is no "we" this time. You must do this one on your own, old friend.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Until I return, yes. YOU are now the best detective in this city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Until I return, yes. YOU are now the best detective in this city.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I cannot tell you and keep you safe. But an... old friend may still be alive. I thought he was gone, but... perhaps not. I must find him again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I cannot tell you and keep you safe. But an... old friend may still be alive. I thought he was gone, but... perhaps not. I must find him again.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: So, farewell my loyal partner. I shall now depart! Look after yourself, because for now... the game is afoot!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, farewell my loyal partner. I shall now depart! Look after yourself, because for now... the game is afoot!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Unfortunately in this situation I have no other choice. YOU are now the best detective in this city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately in this situation I have no other choice. YOU are now the best detective in this city.
Razlo was acting very suspicious.
Razlo is up to something.
Like what?
Who?
How will we turn them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A bounty hunter might give us the evidence we need to catch him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A bounty hunter might give us the evidence we need to catch him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A bounty hunter might give us the evidence we need to catch him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A bounty hunter might give us the evidence we need to catch him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I'm on my own?
Why?
Ava?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: There is at least one prominent bounty hunter operating in this district.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is at least one prominent bounty hunter operating in this district.
Sal Magundi?
Deeala?
Gideon?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Gideon. I have added a Nav Point to your Comm. I recommend you speak to him, but be careful. He is quite dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gideon. I have added a Nav Point to your Comm. I recommend you speak to him, but be careful. He is quite dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes. I have added a Nav Point to your Comm. I recommend you speak to him, but be careful. He's dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I have added a Nav Point to your Comm. I recommend you speak to him, but be careful. He's dangerous.
Where do you go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're abandoning me now of all times?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're abandoning me now of all times?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're abandoning me now of all times?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're abandoning me now of all times?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now?
Who is it?
